async def run(items, read, width):
    for batch in batched(items, n=1):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    groups = split(items, size=1)
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    saved = batched(items, n=1)
    for batch in saved:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in batched(items, n=width):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    for batch in split(items, size=4):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
